group.title: Screen layout
group.description: Columns per row and the field in every spot. Rows with fewer columns show fewer of the spots below.

setting.title: Field in a smaller data screen spot

group.title: Target
group.description: Pace as m:ss in the watch's pace unit, power in W, heart rate in bpm. One end alone is a single value with a tolerance. Every spot showing that live value turns green inside the range, blue below, red above.

group.title: Zones
group.description: Heart rate zones default to the watch's own. Pace zones need the threshold pace, power zones the FTP.

setting.title: Custom zones: Z1-Z5 lower bounds, e.g. 120,140,155,168,180

group.title: Presets
group.description: A preset keeps the screen layout and the target under a name. Pick an action and save: the watch carries it out on its next sync and sets this back to None. On the watch: the data field's settings, Presets.

group.title: License
group.description: 5 free runs, then RunDeck needs a license key (one-time purchase). Paste the key from the purchase e-mail; the watch activates it the next time RunDeck runs with the phone connected.
